audience: vacation rental and property managers who use Operto for guest access and smart devices

useCases.title: See who checks in today
useCases.text: List the properties, then list the reservations of each one. Find the reservations with a check-in today and read the room status.

useCases.title: Look up a reservation and its door codes
useCases.text: List the reservations of a property. Read one reservation for the guest dates and the access codes.

useCases.title: Find smart locks with a low battery
useCases.text: List the locks of each property with battery level and locked state. Plan which batteries to replace.

useCases.title: Find thermostats that are offline
useCases.text: List all thermostats of the organization with their online status. Read one thermostat for its temperature and hold.
